title: Fps Optimized
description: Performance-focused Minecraft modpack featuring popular optimization mods and in-game settings to improve responsiveness, reduce stutters, and provide a smoother gameplay experience.
body:
# 🧩 FPS OPTIMIZED – Minecraft Performance Modpack

FPS OPTIMIZED is a lightweight Minecraft modpack focused on improving performance, reducing stutters, and providing a smoother gameplay experience across a wide range of systems.

Built around well-known optimization mods, the pack is designed for players who want improved responsiveness and stability while preserving the vanilla Minecraft experience.

[![dc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98df16a53357ada12b1156235d9bd3a4cd5b4c04.png)](https://discord.gg/hJpFwaZEk2)

---

## 🚀 Overview

FPS OPTIMIZED combines multiple performance-focused mods and configurations into a single easy-to-use package. The goal is to improve rendering efficiency, reduce unnecessary resource usage, and provide a smoother gameplay experience during exploration, building, multiplayer sessions, and everyday survival gameplay.

The modpack requires minimal setup and is suitable for both new and experienced players looking for a more optimized Minecraft experience.

---

# 🚀 About

Stop playing with low FPS and unnecessary lag. **FPS Optimized** combines carefully selected Fabric performance mods to deliver smoother gameplay, faster chunk loading, lower memory usage, and higher frame rates while preserving the vanilla Minecraft experience.

Whether you're exploring massive worlds, competing in PvP, or playing on SMPs, every included mod is chosen to maximize performance without unnecessary bloat.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# ⚡ Performance

Unlock the full potential of Minecraft with a carefully curated optimization stack.

• Higher average FPS

• Faster chunk loading

• Reduced memory usage

• Better CPU optimization

• Smoother frame pacing

• Faster world loading

### Expected Performance

| Hardware     |    Vanilla FPS | FPS Optimized |
| ------------ | -------------: | ------------: |
| Low-end PC   |      30–60 FPS |   120–220 FPS |
| Mid-range PC |     80–150 FPS |   250–450 FPS |
| High-end PC  | Already Smooth |   Even Better |

> ⚠ Results vary depending on hardware, render distance, shaders, and resource packs.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Every optimization is designed to create a smoother and more responsive gameplay experience.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# 📦 Installation

### ✅ Recommended

1. Install the Modrinth App.
2. Search **FPS Optimized**.
3. Click **Install**.
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy.

### 🛠 Manual Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader.
2. Download the latest version from this page.
3. Import it into your launcher.
4. Allocate at least **4 GB RAM**.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# ❓ FAQ

### Is this compatible with multiplayer?

Yes. Every included optimization mod is client-side unless otherwise specified.

### Will this improve my FPS?

Yes. Most players experience significantly smoother gameplay and higher frame rates depending on their hardware.

### Does it support shaders?

Yes. Iris Shader support is included.

### Can I install additional mods?

Yes, although compatibility with third-party mods cannot be guaranteed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# ⚠ Known Issues

• Performance gains depend on your hardware.

• Heavy shader packs may reduce FPS.

• Some third-party mods may impact compatibility.
